posts.text: The BlackLandcestry app is the solution to the epidemic of stolen Black land.  There’s been a 90% reduction in Black owned farmland in the last century, and a large portion of that land was taken by less than legal or honest means.  Kavon Ward has been helping her community get land restored their rightful owners/heirs. posts.text: Did you know that 40 Mississippi highway patrolmen shot 460 rounds into this building on the Jackson State campus in 1970? They k*lled Phillip Gibbs and James Earl Green, as well as injuring 12 others.  No police officers were charged or convicted in the shooting. An all white grand jury declined any indictment, stating the police were justified.  #hbcu #history #jsu #jacksonstate #theeilove
